BAC's candidates (bac_2024_7_D141, bac_2024_7_D145) focus on general risk framework oversight by the Board and ESG/sustainability committee responsibilities, respectively, without mentioning cybersecurity updates to the Board or Executive Management.

comparisons.peer_summary: The Board, including its Risk Committee and Technology Risk Subcommittee, oversees risk management policies and practices, including cybersecurity risks. The CRO, CIO, and CTO periodically brief the Board on operational and technology risks, while the CISO provides regular briefings on the Cybersecurity Program, emerging threats, mitigation strategies, and regulatory engagements. Directors maintain ongoing dialogue with the CISO and other executives on these topics.
comparisons.comparison: Both Citi and Goldman Sachs describe how senior management provides updates to the Board and Executive Management regarding cybersecurity matters, including specific risk contexts. Citi specifies that these updates occur 'outside of formal meetings' and include 'Russia-specific risks', whereas Goldman Sachs describes 'regular briefings' from the CISO to the Board on cybersecurity programs and threats, noting that directors maintain an 'ongoing dialogue' with the CISO. Both disclose direct executive-to-board communication channels for cybersecurity oversight distinct from formal committee reporting structures.

sentences.text: In addition, senior management has provided updates to Citi's Executive Management Team and the Board, outside of formal meetings, regarding cybersecurity matters (including Russia-specific risks).

The Board also receives regular briefings from our CISO on a range of cybersecurity-related topics, including the status of our Cybersecurity Program, emerging cybersecurity threats, mitigation strategies and related regulatory engagements.
In addition, these are topics on which various directors maintain an ongoing dialogue with our CISO, chief information officer and chief technology officer.

comparisons.peer_topic: Committees and steering groups for cybersecurity risk management
comparisons.peer_summary: Various committees and steering groups oversee the implementation of the cybersecurity risk management strategy and framework. Designated Technology Risk members report to these groups on the Cybersecurity Program and incident prevention efforts, enabling formal escalation and reporting of risks to senior management. These groups are informed about cybersecurity incidents and risks by Technology Risk staff.
comparisons.comparison: While Citi focuses on ad-hoc updates to the Board and Executive Management Team, Goldman Sachs details a structured internal mechanism where 'committees and steering groups' oversee the cybersecurity strategy and receive reports from Technology Risk staff, which then enables 'formal escalation and reporting of risks' to senior management. Both disclosures concern the flow of cybersecurity information from technical/operational teams to senior leadership and the Board, but GS emphasizes the internal committee structure as the intermediary for escalation.

sentences.text: In addition, senior management has provided updates to Citi's Executive Management Team and the Board, outside of formal meetings, regarding cybersecurity matters (including Russia-specific risks).

These committees and steering groups are informed about cybersecurity incidents and risks by designated members of Technology Risk, who periodically report to these committees and steering groups about the Cybersecurity Program, including the efforts of the Technology Risk teams to prevent, detect, mitigate and remediate incidents and threats.
These committees and steering groups enable formal escalation and reporting of risks, and our CISO and other members of Technology Risk provide regular briefings to senior management.

comparisons.peer_topic: Board and Committee Oversight of Cybersecurity
comparisons.peer_summary: The Firm's Board of Directors receives periodic updates from the CIO, CISO, and senior CTOC members concerning cybersecurity matters, including developments, policies, initiatives, and significant incidents. The Audit Committee and Risk Committee assist the Board in this oversight, while the Global Technology Operating Committee (GTOC) governs the Firmwide Global Technology organization and resolves key operational risk matters.
comparisons.comparison: Both Citi and JPMorgan Chase describe their Board receiving updates directly from senior management (CISO/CIO) regarding cybersecurity matters. Citi notes these updates are provided 'outside of formal meetings' and include 'Russia-specific risks'. JPMorgan Chase states the Board receives 'periodic updates' from the CIO and CISO concerning 'cybersecurity and technology developments' and 'significant cybersecurity incidents'. Both highlight direct executive engagement with the Board for cybersecurity oversight, though JPMorgan specifies the content includes program changes and incidents, while Citi highlights geopolitical risk specificity.

sentences.text: In addition, senior management has provided updates to Citi's Executive Management Team and the Board, outside of formal meetings, regarding cybersecurity matters (including Russia-specific risks).

As part of its oversight of management's implementation and maintenance of the Firm's risk management framework, the Firm's Board of Directors receives periodic updates from the CIO, the CISO and senior members of the CTOC concerning cybersecurity matters.

These updates generally include information regarding cybersecurity and technology developments, the Firm's Information Security Program and recommended changes to that program, cybersecurity policies and practices, and ongoing initiatives to improve information security, as well as any significant cybersecurity incidents and the Firm's efforts to address those incidents.

comparisons.peer_topic: Board of Directors and BOTC Oversight of Cybersecurity
comparisons.peer_summary: The Board of Directors oversees cybersecurity risks through the BOTC, which has primary responsibility for monitoring significant operational risk exposures including IT and cybersecurity. The BOTC receives quarterly reports from Technology, Operations, and NFR, reviews significant policies, obtains annual independent assessments, and facilitates direct discussion between senior management and Board members.
comparisons.comparison: Citi and Morgan Stanley both disclose that senior management provides updates to the Board regarding cybersecurity risks, with specific emphasis on the Board's direct involvement. Citi states senior management provides updates 'outside of formal meetings... including Russia-specific risks'. Morgan Stanley notes that at least annually, senior management discusses the 'status of the Cybersecurity Program and key cybersecurity risks with the Board' and that the BOTC Chair 'reports to the Board on cybersecurity risks'. Both firms emphasize direct Board access to cybersecurity leadership updates, though MS formalizes this through the BOTC and annual discussions, while Citi emphasizes ad-hoc/outside meetings.

sentences.text: In addition, senior management has provided updates to Citi's Executive Management Team and the Board, outside of formal meetings, regarding cybersecurity matters (including Russia-specific risks).
As discussed above, material cybersecurity risks are addressed by management-level ERM committees with escalation to the BOTC and Board, as appropriate.

At least annually, senior management representatives in Technology and NFR discuss the status of the Cybersecurity Program and key cybersecurity risks with the Board and, in accordance with the Board's Corporate Governance Policies, all Board members are invited to attend BOTC meetings and have access to meeting materials.
